commit.message:
feat(2d): support 2D Contour on DXF sketches

Add layer/chain picking, per-chain side and direction overrides, ray picking,
open-chain safety checks, meshless verify/stock simulation, and UI/MCP
integration for 2D Contour on placed DXF sketch profiles.

Fixes #1864
Merge upstream/main into issue/1864-contour-dxf-sketches (keep both sides)
fix(sketch): keep whole-sketch source in op page and cache per-frame sketch work

feat(2d): Slot and Trochoidal Slot read DXF sketch chains

A Slot or a Trochoidal Slot now takes one picked chain of a DXF profile.
One closed line-arc slot outline seeds the two ends and the width. One
open straight chain is the centerline: it seeds the two ends, and the
typed width stays. The pick seeds in its own command, so one undo takes
back the pick and the seed (the law of #1504).

Generation judges the stored slot against the picked chain as the world
stands. A slot that left its outline, or whose ends are not the ends of
its centerline, is refused by name.

Refused by name: a closed chain that is not a slot outline (a rectangle,
a circle), a bent open chain, more than one chain, the whole profile as
the source, and a channel narrower than the tool (the Slot refusal now
gives the two numbers).

- motion: `SlotBound::from_centerline`, `centerline`, the `Room::Line`
  room (`slot_room_line.rs`).
- app: `operation/slot_sketch.rs` resolves the picked chain to a slot
  room; `slot_pick`, `job`, the Trochoidal Slot arm and `sketch_model`
  admit it.

Stacked on #2716 (the sketch selection of #1864).

Fixes #1868

fix(2d): settle sketch picks against main's do_not_touch and first traverse

The merge of main left semantic conflicts that git did not flag:
- Do not touch (#2055) matches FeatureSel exhaustively. A sketch chain
  or layer pick is refused by name at the command and at generation.
  The stamp hashes the two new variants.
- Rotary picks refuse a sketch pick with the face-only refusal.
- corner_relief_sim passes the sketch contour plan to WcsYaw::enter.
- The two slot CL goldens take main's first-traverse START line (#2901).

Pins: do_not_touch_refuses_a_sketch_chain_or_layer_by_name,
protected_project_roundtrips_and_refuses_a_future_version (v73 step-up),
layer_and_chain_picks_per_chain_overrides_undo_and_project_v74_roundtrip.

Refs #1868

identity with the profile entity and chain ID. Key sketch highlights by
their placed pose, including the absence of stock.

and per-chain overrides. Readers limited to v73 refuse these files.
Existing v73 files migrate to v74 and keep protected selections.
